purpose: Fifth expanded public source layer focused on glycosylated natural products, NRPS/RiPP macrocyclic peptides, controlled or toxic alkaloid skeletons, hydrolyzable tannins, lipid mediator and endocannabinoid boundaries, iminosugar glycomimetics, macrocyclic degraders and molecular glues, and photoresponsive chemical-biology probes.

promotion_requirements: explicit precursor structures before template or proposal promotion
separate biosynthetic-anchor, chiral-pool, conjugation, photoresponsive-probe, or delivery policy
route-specific stereochemistry, site-selectivity, protecting-group, linkage, and biological-context review
antimicrobial stewardship, controlled-substance, toxic-alkaloid, bioactive-degrader, photoaffinity, phototoxicity, or lipid-signaling review where relevant
safety_scope: records intentionally avoid quantities, operational procedures, and synthesis conditions
controlled alkaloid, antimicrobial peptide, degrader, photoaffinity, photopharmacology, and endocannabinoid entries are high-level route priors only

families.name: Glycosylated natural products and macrolide glycodiversification
families.strategic_principle: Separate aglycone construction, unusual sugar biosynthesis or donor preparation, and glycosyltransferase or chemical glycosylation site policy. Sugar identity and attachment position are strategic route metadata, not ordinary protecting-group decoration.

families.name: Nonribosomal and ribosomal macrocyclic peptide natural products
families.strategic_principle: Map peptide natural products to assembly-line, cyclase, and tailoring logic before applying ordinary peptide retrosynthesis. Macrocyclization site, heterocycle oxidation state, epimerization, N-methylation, and fatty-acyl tailoring are route-defining.

families.name: Morphinan, tropane, and quinolizidine alkaloid skeletons
families.strategic_principle: Treat regulated or toxic alkaloid skeletons as compliance-gated route-critique records. Strategic analysis should identify biosynthetic branch points and skeleton-forming cyclizations while avoiding operational route generation for controlled or hazardous targets.

families.name: Hydrolyzable tannins, ellagitannins, and polyphenol oxidative-coupling scaffolds
families.strategic_principle: Expose glucose or polyol galloylation, galloyl ester pattern, and biomimetic oxidative C-C/C-O coupling as the strategic operations. Axial chirality and oligomerization state must be tracked before route scoring.

families.name: Lipid mediators, endocannabinoids, and specialized pro-resolving mediators
families.strategic_principle: Separate lipid-chain stereochemistry, oxidation pattern, amide or glycerol ester linkage, and membrane/lipid-signaling context. Do not score lipid mediators as simple fatty-acid derivatives when double-bond geometry and oxygenation sequence define activity.

families.name: Iminosugars, azasugars, and carbohydrate-mimetic glycosidase inhibitors
families.strategic_principle: Treat nitrogen-in-the-ring sugar mimics as stereochemical carbohydrate objects. Strategic routes should preserve or explain carbohydrate configuration, ring nitrogen placement, N-substitution, and glycosidase-transition-state mimicry.

families.name: Macrocyclic degraders, PROTACs, and molecular glue induced-proximity scaffolds
families.strategic_principle: Separate target ligand, E3-ligase recruiter, linker or macrocycle constraint, and induced-proximity biology. Chemical convergence alone is insufficient unless ternary-complex or molecular-glue metadata is present.

families.name: Photoaffinity probes, photoswitches, and photopharmacology motifs
families.strategic_principle: Separate parent ligand, photoreactive or photoswitchable handle, enrichment/tethering handle, and irradiation/biological-compatibility metadata. Probe derivatization is strategic only when target engagement is preserved and photochemical risk is explicit.

anchors.name: Natural-product aglycone plus unusual sugar donor or glycosyltransferase module
NRPS/RiPP peptide assembly and cyclization module
Biosynthetic branch point for regulated or toxic alkaloid skeletons
Galloylated glucose/polyol precursor and HHDP oxidative-coupling pattern
PUFA-derived lipid mediator chain, oxygenation pattern, and polar linkage
Target ligand, E3 recruiter, linker/macrocycle, and induced-proximity biology
Parent ligand plus photoreactive/photoswitchable handle and reporter/tether

disconnections.name: Glycosylated natural product to aglycone plus activated sugar donor

target_features: O-, N-, or C-linked sugar appended to a natural-product aglycone

forward_logic: construct or source the aglycone with the correct acceptor site
prepare or biosynthetically access the matching nucleotide sugar donor
select chemical glycosylation, glycosyltransferase, or pathway-engineering policy with site metadata
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward routes that explicitly separate aglycone formation from sugar-donor and attachment-site policy.

risks: enzymatic substrate scope may be narrow

evidence.citation: Natural-product sugar biosynthesis review describes unusual sugars, glycosyltransferases, and glycodiversification.
Comprehensive review analyzes glycosylated bacterial natural products and glycosyl regiospecificity.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high when aglycone, sugar donor, and attachment site are explicit

disconnections.name: Glycodiversification by sugar-biosynthesis and glycosyltransferase module exchange

target_features: same aglycone with altered sugar identity

forward_logic: define whether sugar diversity is chemical, chemoenzymatic, or pathway-engineered
track donor activation and glycosyltransferase tolerance
avoid treating sugar exchange as a generic late-stage substituent swap
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use glycodiversification only as an advisory source unless donor, enzyme, and acceptor compatibility are reviewed.

risks: bioactivity may invert with sugar changes

evidence.citation: Review discusses enzyme engineering for natural-product glycodiversification with glycosyltransferases.
Rare microbial sugar exchange review covers glycosyltransferase-mediated natural-product sugar replacement.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit enzyme and donor-scope metadata

disconnections.name: NRPS/RiPP macrocycle to linear precursor and cyclase/thioesterase release policy

break_bonds: macrocyclic amide, ester, or side-chain linkage
forward_logic: map the macrocycle closure site and linear peptide sequence
choose chemical macrocyclization or enzyme-catalyzed cyclization boundary
track D-residues, N-methylation, lipidation, and tailoring before route scoring
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward explicit macrocycle-opening to a sequence-aware precursor; penalize routes that ignore noncanonical residue and tailoring logic.

risks: antimicrobial or toxin context for some cyclic peptides

evidence.citation: Biosynthetic macrocyclic peptide review covers NRPS thioesterase/cyclase and RiPP cyclization strategies.
Macrocyclization review summarizes modern cyclic peptide and peptidomimetic closure strategies.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high when sequence, closure site, and tailoring metadata are explicit

disconnections.name: Peptide thiazoline/oxazoline heterocycle to Cys/Ser/Thr cyclodehydration precursor

target_classes: azole-rich RiPPs and NRPS natural products
target_features: thiazoline, thiazole, oxazoline, or oxazole embedded in a peptide

break_bonds: heterocycle C-N/C-S or C-N/C-O bonds traced to cyclodehydrated amino-acid side chain
forward_logic: map the heterocycle to a cysteine, serine, or threonine residue
define whether NRPS Cy domain, RiPP TOMM machinery, or chemical cyclodehydration is the route boundary
track thiazoline/oxazoline versus thiazole/oxazole oxidation state
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Treat embedded peptide azolines as strategic tailoring motifs, not generic heteroaryl fragments.

risks: chemical dehydration can scramble sensitive residues

evidence.citation: NRPS heterocyclization-domain study explains formation of thiazoline and oxazoline rings from Cys/Ser/Thr residues.
Cyclisation review covers thiazole and oxazole formation in ribosomally synthesized modified peptides.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for residue-to-heterocycle mapping and oxidation-state policy

disconnections.name: Morphinan skeleton to reticuline/salutaridine biosynthetic branch point

break_bonds: C-C phenol-coupling bond forming the promorphinan skeleton
forward_logic: map target to reticuline stereochemistry and salutaridine/promorphinan branch point
separate skeleton-forming oxidative coupling from late O-demethylation or reduction policy
treat regulated morphinan targets as compliance-gated critique records only
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use only for high-level route critique; do not promote into operational proposal generation for controlled morphinan targets.

evidence.citation: Opium poppy evolution study describes morphinan biosynthesis from reticuline to thebaine.
Salutaridine synthase article identifies stereoselective C-C phenol coupling in morphine biosynthesis.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: low unless legal review and non-operational critique-only mode are explicit

disconnections.name: Tropane ester to tropinone/tropine core plus acyl/tropyl moiety

break_bonds: tropane skeleton traced to tropinone/tropine branch point
forward_logic: separate tropane core formation, tropine/pseudotropine stereochemistry, and acyl partner
track biosynthetic source or reviewed core policy
gate regulated or toxic tropane targets before any proposal-source use
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use tropane entries for compliance-gated route critique and anchor recognition, not default stock closure.

evidence.citation: Tropane alkaloid review covers chemistry, pharmacology, biosynthesis, and production.
Tropane and granatane biosynthesis review summarizes pathway and metabolic-engineering context.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: low unless toxicology/legal review and core stereochemistry are explicit

disconnections.name: Quinolizidine alkaloid to lysine/cadaverine-derived skeleton policy

break_bonds: quinolizidine ring traced to cadaverine-derived cyclization logic
forward_logic: map target class to quinolizidine structural subtype
separate lysine/cadaverine biosynthetic logic from late oxidations and acylations
flag food-safety, toxicity, and medicinal-use context
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use as a toxic-alkaloid route-critique prior; require explicit subtype and safety metadata.

evidence.citation: Quinolizidine alkaloid biosynthesis review discusses lysine/cadaverine origin and pathway uncertainties.
Lupin quinolizidine review covers toxicity, biosynthesis, and grain-quality implications.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: low unless quinolizidine subtype and safety context are explicit

disconnections.name: Ellagitannin HHDP unit to adjacent galloyl groups on glucose/polyol

break_bonds: HHDP C-C bond traced to oxidative coupling of adjacent galloyl esters
forward_logic: assign galloyl positions on glucose or polyol
plan oxidative C-C coupling that creates HHDP and axial chirality
track hydrolysis/degalloylation and oligomerization state
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward routes that expose galloyl-position logic and HHDP atropisomerism before oxidation.

evidence.citation: Ellagitannin structural review describes HHDP formation by oxidative C-C coupling of neighboring galloyl groups.
Hydrolyzable tannin biosynthesis review summarizes galloyl glucose to HHDP oxidative-coupling pathway.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for galloyl-position and HHDP-stereochemistry metadata

disconnections.name: Oligomeric ellagitannin to monomeric galloyl/HHDP building blocks

break_bonds: intermolecular C-C or C-O oxidative-coupling links between tannin monomers
forward_logic: reduce the target to monomeric galloyl/HHDP pattern units
define oxidative oligomerization or valoneoyl/chebuloyl formation policy
keep hydrolysis and ester migration risks explicit
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Avoid scoring oligomeric tannins as generic polyphenol decoration; require monomer and coupling topology.

evidence.citation: Ellagic acid review summarizes galloyl glucose, HHDP oxidative coupling, and ellagitannin structural diversity.
Ellagitannin cancer-review chemistry section describes monomers and oxidative-coupled dimers.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit monomer topology and oxidative-coupling assignment

disconnections.name: Endocannabinoid to arachidonoyl chain plus ethanolamide or glycerol linkage

forward_logic: separate PUFA chain identity and double-bond geometry from polar headgroup
choose amide or glycerol ester linkage policy
track enzymatic metabolism and lipid-signaling context
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward routes that preserve PUFA geometry and distinguish amide from glycerol ester mediator classes.

evidence.citation: Endocannabinoid review covers anandamide, 2-AG, and metabolic routes.
Endocannabinoid system overview discusses eCB amide/ester families and biosynthetic enzymes.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for correct PUFA geometry and polar-linkage metadata

disconnections.name: Specialized pro-resolving mediator to PUFA oxygenation and stereochemical sequence

target_features: defined E/Z double-bond geometry and stereochemistry

break_bonds: oxygenated PUFA traced to staged oxygenation/epoxide or hydroxy precursors
forward_logic: assign AA/EPA/DHA precursor family
track lipoxygenase-like oxygenation positions and stereochemistry
avoid generic fatty-acid simplification that loses double-bond geometry
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use SPM entries only when oxygenation position, stereochemistry, and double-bond geometry are retained.

evidence.citation: SPM chemistry and biology review summarizes lipoxin and resolvin synthesis and analog design.
SPM immune-response review describes AA/EPA/DHA-derived lipoxin, resolvin, protectin, and maresin families.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for preserved stereochemistry and oxygenation sequence

disconnections.name: Iminosugar to chiral carbohydrate precursor with ring nitrogen installation

target_features: polyhydroxylated piperidine, pyrrolidine, indolizidine, or azepane

break_bonds: C-N ring bond traced to carbohydrate-derived aminoalcohol precursor
forward_logic: select carbohydrate or asymmetric precursor that encodes most stereocenters
install ring nitrogen while preserving sugar configuration
defer N-alkyl substituent changes until core stereochemistry is verified
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward chiral-pool routes that explicitly preserve iminosugar stereochemistry and ring size.

evidence.citation: Deoxynojirimycin review describes DNJ as an iminosugar/azasugar and covers occurrence and chemistry.
Iminosugar stereochemistry study summarizes ring size, stereochemistry, and N-substituent effects.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high when carbohydrate configuration and ring nitrogen placement are explicit

disconnections.name: Iminosugar N-substitution and glycomimetic activity policy

target_features: iminosugar core plus N-alkyl or appended side chain

forward_logic: construct the iminosugar core before N-substituent diversification
track how N-substitution changes binding, permeability, and selectivity
distinguish pharmacophore side-chain tuning from core-skeleton synthesis
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Do not score N-alkylation as strategic progress unless the iminosugar core and biological role are already explicit.

risks: side chain changes selectivity and toxicity

evidence.citation: Cystic-fibrosis iminosugar review covers synthesis and therapeutic applications of iminosugar glycomimetics.
Glycomimetic design review notes DNJ-derived drugs and carbohydrate bioisosteres.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for core-first strategy and N-substituent activity metadata

disconnections.name: Macrocyclic or constrained PROTAC to target ligand, E3 recruiter, and linker/macrocycle

forward_logic: prepare target ligand and E3 recruiter as separate modules
define linker vector, length, polarity, and optional macrocyclization
require ternary-complex or degradation metadata before promotion
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Chemical convergence gets credit only when target, E3, linker vectors, and degradation rationale are all explicit.

evidence.citation: PROTAC design review discusses target ligand, E3 ligand, linker, and macrocyclic PROTAC examples.
Macrocyclic peptide degrader review describes PROTAC and molecular-glue distinctions and macrocyclic degrader opportunities.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate only with target/E3/linker and degradation metadata

disconnections.name: Molecular glue to E3-ligase/neosubstrate induced-interface policy

break_bonds: do not force bifunctional linker disconnection; treat as interface-stabilizing small-molecule scaffold
forward_logic: identify glue scaffold and E3/neosubstrate interface evidence
separate medicinal chemistry scaffold synthesis from induced-proximity biology
require proteomic or structural mode-of-action metadata before proposal-source promotion
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Do not rewrite molecular glues as PROTACs; score them through induced-interface evidence.

evidence.citation: E3 ligase ligandability review contrasts PROTACs and molecular glue degraders in targeted protein degradation.
Targeted degradation review summarizes molecular glue and PROTAC mechanisms and applications.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate only with E3/neosubstrate and mode-of-action metadata

disconnections.name: Photoaffinity probe to parent ligand, photoreactive handle, and enrichment/reporter handle

forward_logic: preserve parent-ligand target engagement while adding minimal photoreactive handle
choose diazirine, benzophenone, aryl azide, or alternative handle based on size and photochemistry
keep enrichment handle and photolysis compatibility separate from parent synthesis
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward probe routes only when parent activity, handle position, and photochemical compatibility are explicit.

evidence.citation: Photoaffinity probe review describes benzophenone, aryl azide, and diazirine photoreactive units.
Recent photoaffinity chemistry review focuses on benzophenone and diazirine radical precursors.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for parent-ligand preserving handle placement and reporter policy

disconnections.name: Photoswitchable ligand to parent pharmacophore plus azobenzene/photochromic switch

target_features: parent pharmacophore retained in one isomer

forward_logic: identify parent ligand vectors that tolerate azologization or photoswitch insertion
track trans/cis geometry, wavelength window, thermal relaxation, and biological compatibility
separate photoswitch design from target-binding pharmacophore synthesis
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Score photopharmacology routes by switch-state activity and photophysical metadata, not only by synthesis of an azobenzene.

evidence.citation: Photopharmacology DHFR study discusses azobenzene photoswitchable drug design and cis/trans activity.
Ion-channel photopharmacology review describes modular photoswitchable ligands and azobenzene use.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate only with switch-state activity and photophysical metadata

source_notes.summary: The v6 expansion promotes the backlog families for glycosylated natural products, NRPS/RiPP peptide natural products, morphinan/tropane/quinolizidine alkaloid critique, ellagitannins, endocannabinoid/SPM lipid mediators, iminosugar glycomimetics, macrocyclic degraders/molecular glues, and photoresponsive probes.

Controlled alkaloid, toxic alkaloid, antimicrobial/bioactive peptide, cannabinoid/lipid mediator, degrader, photoaffinity, and photopharmacology records are advisory. Promotion to proposal generation requires explicit legal, safety, stewardship, toxicology, photochemistry, or biological-mode review as applicable.
